notes.title: Geometry Dash update seven years in the making smashes Steam records
notes.notes:
Almost seven years after its last major update, Geometry Dash 2.2 has released, seeing the game have an astronomical spike in players on Steam and hit a new concurrent player peak, as loads of free levels, modes, and more arrive for the music platforming game. Players are coming back in droves to Geometry Dash, making it feel like 2013 all over again.

notes.title: Update 2.2 Info and Trailer
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Unfortunately, 2.2 will not be coming in October as promised and is delayed to November. It just wouldn't feel right to release an update this big without stable servers and proper bugfixing. I tried my hardest to make it in time, but some work took longer than expected. 

All I can do is apologize and do my best in these final weeks. I'm really looking forward to sharing all these new features with the community. 

Despite the delay, the update is still very close, which is why we have made a final release trailer. Check it out!

/RubRub

notes.title: Have you played Geometry Dash?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

There’s an episode of Black Books where Manny discovers that he can play the piano perfectly on his first attempt. In my family’s lexicon, comprised almost entirely of TV and film references, “I’m Bill Baileying it” has become an oft-used phrase that means instant and improvised expertise. “I don’t know what’s happening or how on earth I’m doing this, and I want it to end right now, but also I want it to keep going forever.”

Now, have you ever played Geometry Dash?

(more…)

notes.title: Update 2.01
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Update 2.01 is now available on Steam and will be available on iOS, Google Play, Amazon and Windows Phone in a few days. Apple will have to wait for the review time, but shouldn't take more than a week.

The update fixes a lot of the bugs from 2.0, and should also improve performance. Hopefully levels with a lot of moving objects won't lag as much :)

The update also includes a stat recount system that will recount all stars, demons and collected user coins. There was a bug in 2.0 that gave users extra stars/coins, this fixes and resets that problem.

The stat recount will also remove stars gained from cheats/bugs/exploits. So if you lose stats when the update comes out, you will know why
smile emoticon

Hopefully the system should be more stable now and the leaderboards should slowly become more cheat-free :)

New mappacks are in the works and should be done in a few days!

Thanks everyone for your awesome support! I will upload the first update 2.1 promo in a day or two :D

/RubRub

- Editor preview mode

- Lots of bug fixes
- Secrets...

Thank you for playing Geometry Dash! Since this is a very big update, there are probably a few sneaky bugs that I have missed. Please contact support@robtopgames.com for help with any issues.
